decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in a core application area for the firm, this resin injection unit would likely be retained while management waits for clearer market feedback and uses existing engineering and service slack to support it.

Although another newly launched resin injection unit may create some internal comparison pressure, its close fit with the firm’s established injection and material-handling business makes continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely within the firm’s main product logic and customer base, so a German medium-sized machinery firm would typically give it more time before judging it below aspiration.

This manual airless spray gun is highly aligned with the firm’s longstanding spray-equipment capabilities and distributor channels, which lowers the need for problemistic search away from the product.

Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a product line with several models in a core category, management is likely to see enough strategic relevance and adaptation potential to keep it on the market.

The data logger is somewhat less central than the firm’s mechanical equipment lines, but its role in supporting innovative application technology and installed equipment means management would still be inclined to continue it despite higher uncertainty.
